basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhubaneswar Accounts Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar has invited online applications for 3 Accounts Trainee posts on a temporary basis, with a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 23,000/- per month for a one-year traineeship. Applications are accepted only through the online portal from 10 November 2026 to 24 November 2026, under Advertisement No. Rectt.- Temporary/04/Non-Teaching/2026 dated 02.11.2026.

qualification.details: Candidates must have passed the B.Com with 55% of marks. The notice also lists essential skills: expert-level knowledge of Tally Accounting Software, MS Office, and online GST/IT compliance procedures. | Scanned copies of educational certificates and experience certificates must be attached with the online application. The notice states that experience will not be considered without the experience certificate.

salary_details.details: The Accounts Trainee receives Rs. 23,000/- Per Month as consolidated remuneration. The duration is one year, purely on a temporary basis, with no scope for extension. The engagement is purely temporary in nature and has nothing to do with a permanent position in the Institute. | Working hours are six days a week from 9 A.M. to 6 P.M.

selection_process: The mode of selection is written test/skill test and/or interview. The notice does not give the dates
venue or syllabus of these stages. In case of any dispute or ambiguity in the process of selection
IIT Bhubaneswar is final and binding.
how_to_apply: Read the advertisement before filling up the online application form.
Submit the application only through the online portal between 10.11.2026 and 24.11.2026.
Attach scanned copies of educational certificates and experience certificates with the online application.
Do not send a hardcopy of the Online Application Form to the Institute, as it is not required.
For any difficulty in filling up the form, contact the Recruitment Cell on 0674-7134815 or at [email protected].
The notice does not print the web address of the application portal.
Scanned copies of experience certificates, if claiming experience
important_instructions: All applications must be submitted ONLY through the online portal. Experience will not be considered without the experience certificate. The engagement is purely temporary and has nothing to do with a permanent position in the Institute. The one-year duration has no scope for extension.

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 3 seats.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed the B.Com with 55% of marks. The notice also lists essential skills: expert-level knowledge of Tally Accounting Software, MS Office, and online GST/IT compliance procedures. Scanned copies of educational certificates and experience certificates must be attached with the online application. The notice states that experience will not be considered without the experience certificate. The candidates' age should preferably not exceed 27 years as on the last date of submission of application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The Accounts Trainee receives Rs. 23,000/- Per Month as consolidated remuneration. The duration is one year, purely on a temporary basis, with no scope for extension. The engagement is purely temporary in nature and has nothing to do with a permanent position in the Institute. Working hours are six days a week from 9 A.M. to 6 P.M.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhubaneswar Accounts Trainee Job Description
content_sections.text: Compilation and finalization of annual accounts, budgeting, auditing etc. Compliance related to direct and indirect taxation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Bhubaneswar Accounts Trainee
content_sections.text: The notice does not print the web address of the application portal. Scanned copies of educational certificates Scanned copies of experience certificates, if claiming experience

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is written test/skill test and/or interview. The notice does not give the dates, venue or syllabus of these stages. In case of any dispute or ambiguity in the process of selection, the decision of the Director, IIT Bhubaneswar is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: All applications must be submitted ONLY through the online portal. Experience will not be considered without the experience certificate. The engagement is purely temporary and has nothing to do with a permanent position in the Institute. The one-year duration has no scope for extension.

faq.question: Q1. How many Accounts Trainee posts are there at IIT Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: There are 03 vacancies for Accounts Trainee on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Bhubaneswar Accounts Trainee?
faq.answer: The closing date for online applications is 24.11.2026. The opening date is 10.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIT Bhubaneswar Accounts Trainee?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the B.Com with 55% of marks, along with expert-level knowledge of Tally Accounting Software, MS Office, and online GST/IT compliance procedures.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIT Bhubaneswar Accounts Trainee?
faq.answer: The age should preferably not exceed 27 years as on the last date of submission of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for IIT Bhubaneswar Accounts Trainee?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 23,000/- Per Month, as consolidated remuneration.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IIT Bhubaneswar Accounts Trainee?
faq.answer: Apply only through the online portal, attaching scanned educational and experience certificates. A hardcopy of the Online Application Form is not required to be sent to the Institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIT Bhubaneswar Accounts Trainee?
faq.answer: The mode of selection is written test/skill test and/or interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT Bhubaneswar Accounts Trainee job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary for one year with no scope for extension, and it has nothing to do with a permanent position in the Institute.

faq.question: Q9. What are the working hours of the Accounts Trainee at IIT Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: Working hours are six days a week from 9 A.M. to 6 P.M.

faq.question: Q10. Whom should I contact if I face difficulty in filling the form?
faq.answer: Contact the Recruitment Cell on 0674-7134815 or at [email protected].
